title: Be in the negative: I'm not, isn't, aren't

objective.en: Make the verb be negative with not and its short forms: I'm not tired, He isn't here, We aren't hungry, You're not late.
objective.fr: Mettre le verbe be à la forme négative avec not et ses formes courtes : I'm not tired, He isn't here, We aren't hungry.
objective.de: Das Verb be mit not und seinen Kurzformen verneinen: I'm not tired, He isn't here, We aren't hungry.

label.en: Negative with I, he, she, it
label.fr: La négation avec I, he, she, it
label.de: Verneinung mit I, he, she, it

instructions.en: Read the explanation and the examples.
instructions.fr: Lisez l’explication et les exemples.
instructions.de: Lies die Erklärung und die Beispiele.

text.en:
To make **be** negative, put `not` after `am`, `is` or `are`. With I, you say `I am not` or `I'm not`.

With he, she, it and one person's name, use `is not`, short: `isn't` or `'s not`.

- `I'm not tired.`
- `He isn't here.`
- `She's not hungry.`
- Never say `amn't`.
text.fr:
Pour mettre **be** à la forme négative, placez `not` après `am`, `is` ou `are`. Avec I, on dit `I am not` ou `I'm not`.

Avec he, she, it et le prénom d'une personne, on utilise `is not`, en forme courte : `isn't` ou `'s not`.

- `I'm not tired.`
- `He isn't here.`
- `She's not hungry.`
- Ne dites jamais `amn't`.
text.de:
Um **be** zu verneinen, setze `not` nach `am`, `is` oder `are`. Bei I sagt man `I am not` oder `I'm not`.

Bei he, she, it und dem Namen einer Person benutzt man `is not`, kurz: `isn't` oder `'s not`.

- `I'm not tired.`
- `He isn't here.`
- `She's not hungry.`
- Sag nie `amn't`.

label.fr: La négation avec you, we, they

instructions.en: Read the explanation and the examples.
instructions.fr: Lisez l’explication et les exemples.
instructions.de: Lies die Erklärung und die Beispiele.

heading.en: are not with you, we, they
heading.fr: are not avec you, we, they
heading.de: are not mit you, we, they

text.en:
With you, we and they, use `are not`, short: `aren't` or `'re not`.

With plural nouns, also use `aren't`. Compare `He isn't` (one) and `They aren't` (more than one).

- `You're not late.`
- `We aren't hungry.`
- `The children aren't here.`
text.fr:
Avec you, we et they, on utilise `are not`, en forme courte : `aren't` ou `'re not`.

Avec un nom pluriel, on utilise aussi `aren't`. Comparez `He isn't` (un seul) et `They aren't` (plusieurs).

- `You're not late.`
- `We aren't hungry.`
- `The children aren't here.`
text.de:
Bei you, we und they benutzt man `are not`, kurz: `aren't` oder `'re not`.

Bei Pluralnomen benutzt man ebenfalls `aren't`. Vergleiche `He isn't` (einer) und `They aren't` (mehrere).

- `You're not late.`
- `We aren't hungry.`
- `The children aren't here.`
